---
title: Build an app
description: A Calimero app is Rust compiled to WASM — its state and the methods that change it. The cluster stores, replicates and serves it.
---

import { CardGrid, LinkCard } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';
import Flow from '../../../components/Flow.astro';

A Calimero app is a Rust crate compiled to WASM. You declare its **state**, built from the SDK's collection types,
and its **methods**: calls that change the state, and views that read it. You write no storage, sync, encryption or
networking code. The cluster runs each call on the instance's leader, replicates the result, and serves it to
signed-in callers over a sealed channel.

<Flow
	steps={[
		{ k: 'cargo mero new', title: 'Scaffold', text: 'A crate with SDK pins, the package id and a test.' },
		{ k: 'cargo test', title: 'Test', text: 'TestHost runs your logic in-process, no node needed.' },
		{ k: 'cargo mero build', title: 'Build', text: 'WASM with its ABI embedded.' },
		{ k: 'cargo mero bundle', title: 'Sign', text: 'A signed .mpk, your release.' },
		{ k: 'cargo mero publish', title: 'Publish', text: 'Upload it to the app registry.', accent: true },
	]}
/>

The toolchain is [`cargo mero`](https://calimero-network.github.io/core/build/cargo-mero/), which ships in the core
repository. Install it with `cargo install cargo-mero`.
